=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:519-534 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow installs Python dependencies even when `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false`.
  WHY: That wastes time and network resources before a guaranteed failure; reviewers ranged from low/efficiency-only to critical, so the highest severity is retained.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:527 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The warning about skipping renderer dependency installation does not make the ensuing validation failure clear.
  WHY: This can make a hard failure sound optional.
- docs/validation-templates-plan.md:306-321 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The plan document's checklist and snapshot table disagree on milestone status.
  WHY: The same milestone is shown with conflicting statuses, which makes the document internally inconsistent.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:122-125 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: When the GitHub API lookup fails, the code silently falls back to `{"jobs":[]}`.
  WHY: That hides degraded diagnostic data and can obscure the root cause.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:174-178 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The untracked-file read loop depends on the earlier non-empty-file guard to avoid empty-input edge cases.
  WHY: That ordering dependency is brittle and could break if the guard changes.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:175-200 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Untracked file paths are echoed directly into diagnostic output without sanitization.
  WHY: Control characters or terminal escapes in filenames could distort logs or terminal output.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:188-197 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Permission or read errors in the untracked-file content probe are reported as `[binary file omitted]` instead of the real failure.
  WHY: That hides genuine file-access problems and makes the diagnostics look intentional.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:444-448 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: FIX_ID values are inserted into markdown and logs without validation.
  WHY: A malformed value could inject backticks or other characters into rendered output.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:61 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Users who explicitly set `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` do not get a migration note explaining the new `harness_error` behavior.
  WHY: That makes the breaking change harder to discover.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2263-2269 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Exit code 14 covers both missing python3 >= 3.9 and renderer execution failure.
  WHY: Those are distinct root causes, so one shared message makes diagnosis harder.
- tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:217-223 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The template-mode test still asserts against a log line from the old validate.env requirement.
  WHY: That assertion may be checking behavior the new contract no longer requires.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
